findings.title: Mermaid file import is not idempotent
findings.why_it_matters: A trusted MCP client may retry a tool advertised as idempotent without another approval. Repeating open_mermaid_file with the same arguments creates another uniquely named persisted BPMN file, so the shared IDEMPOTENT_UPDATE preset hides a tool-specific additive effect and can silently accumulate duplicate diagrams.
findings.suggested_fix: Advertise open_mermaid_file with the ADDITIVE tuple (including idempotentHint: false), update EXPECTED_ANNOTATIONS, and add a repeated-call probe that demonstrates the second call creates an additional stored diagram.
evidence: src/server/tools.ts:593 assigns IDEMPOTENT_UPDATE, whose idempotentHint is true at lines 33-38.
src/server/handlers.ts:312-313 routes every call through importXml and replaces the current context; src/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.ts:931-933 assigns defaultFilename and persists the import.
src/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.ts:1430-1441 includes a newly generated UUID in every default filename, so identical repeated calls write distinct .bpmn files.

tests/contracts/tool-annotations.test.ts:52 repeats the same incorrect tuple, while the repeated-call test at lines 152-171 exercises only update_element and save, allowing this semantic mismatch to pass.

testing_gaps: The idempotency behavior test covers only update_element and save; it does not exercise open_mermaid_file, whose persistence behavior differs from the shared IDEMPOTENT_UPDATE category.
